crossRefs.note: The land had rest forty years, then Othniel the son of Kenaz died.
“So let all your enemies perish, Yahweh, but let those who love him be as the sun when it rises in its strength.” Then…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. Then the land had rest eighty years.
translations.bsb: So Moab was subdued under the hand of Israel that day, and the land had rest for eighty years.
translations.kjv: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. And the land had rest fourscore years.
translations.asv: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. And the land had rest fourscore years.
